principle.only_measured.cmd: python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('FACTS.json', encoding='utf-8'))['facts'];bad=[k for k,v in d.items() if not (isinstance(v,dict) and str(v.get('cmd','')).strip())];print('facts_without_cmd=%d' % len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
principle.only_measured.note: numbers/behavior trust measurement only; every fact must carry a re-run command

principle.number_once.note: each number is produced once and re-reconciled every commit: documents cite it as [[key]], never hand-copy it

principle.hard_needs_criterion.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import doc;p=doc._cmd_shape_problems();print('shape_problems=%d' % len(p));sys.exit(1 if p else 0)"
principle.hard_needs_criterion.note: a rule is hard only if it has a machine criterion; without one it does not enter the table at all (there is no advisory state)

principle.ran_is_not_passed.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import registry, criteria;gs=registry.gates()[0];p=criteria.off_reason_problems(gs);print('off_reason_ok gates=%d problems=%d' % (len(gs), len(p)));sys.exit(0 if gs and not p else 1)"
principle.ran_is_not_passed.note: "ran" and "ran and passed" are different statements, and so are "off" and "ran": a gate that can go off must declare why, and an empty traversal must say so

principle.falsifiable.note: claims must be falsifiable: always-true shortcuts are swept by AST and any hit fails

principle.declared_not_globbed.note: predicates are declarations, not filenames: the execution surface reads registry --run <phase>

principle.zero_language.note: zero language in the core: user-visible messages go through M(code); machine contracts are untranslatable by construction

principle.machine_rows.note: machine rows are defined in one place, machine.ROWS; the shell side has a behavior reconciler

principle.three_readmes.note: the three-language READMEs are three copies of one assertion: change one, change all three in the same batch

principle.snapshot_hygiene.note: a mutable global imported across modules is a value copy (stale snapshot): read via the module attribute instead

principle.assertion_lifecycle.note: a retracted claim must not quietly return as current state

principle.no_retired_names.note: retired names must not appear as current state; sha provenance and age are checkable

principle.open_questions_settle.note: every unresolved open question must carry a runnable settler

principle.selfcert_harness.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import registry;u=registry.modules()[1];print('undeclared_modules=%d' % len(u));sys.exit(1 if u else 0)"
principle.selfcert_harness.note: every gate must have a --selftest entry (written but never run = decoration)

principle.doc_references_real.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import doc;d=doc.dangling_references();[print('dangling=%d %s.%s@%s' % (len(d),m,s_,f)) for f,m,s_ in d] or print('dangling=0');sys.exit(1 if d else 0)"
principle.doc_references_real.note: a document must not point at a symbol that does not exist

principle.host_agnostic.cmd: python3 -c "import os,sys;w=['.'+chr(122)+chr(99)+chr(111)+chr(100)+chr(101)+'/','ZCODE_'+'PROJECT_DIR','hook'+'SpecificOutput'];bad=[(d,f) for d in ('zreflect','reflect-hooks') for r,_,fs in os.walk(d) for f in fs if f.endswith(('.py','.sh')) and any(k in open(os.path.join(r,f),encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read() for k in w)];print('host_coupled=%d' % len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
principle.host_agnostic.note: the suite's source recognizes no host's directory names / config formats (host wiring belongs to the consumer)

principle.no_echo_between_carriers.cmd: python3 -c "import glob,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import doc,echoes,ledger;f=(echoes.forms_from_rules(doc.RULES)+echoes.forms_from_ledger(ledger.load('FACTS.json'),doc.RULES)+echoes.forms_from_questions(sorted(glob.glob('questions/*.md'))));h=echoes.echo_problems(f);[print('echo=%s~%s(%.3f)' % (a,b,r)) for r,a,b in h] or print('echoes=0 of %d forms' % len(f));sys.exit(1 if h else 0)"
principle.no_echo_between_carriers.note: a near-copy of an assertion in two carriers is a hand-copy: one fact lives in one carrier, and a quotation must name its source

principle.exec_position_is_a_command.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import criteria;bad=criteria.all_exec_position_problems();[print(p) for p in bad] or print('prose_positions=%d' % len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
principle.exec_position_is_a_command.note: every execution position (stamp cmd / pin version_read / Settling / evidence) must hold a runnable command, not prose

principle.comments_earn_their_place.note: explanation volume (docstring + comments) must fit AST complexity under `mismatch`, or carry no docstrings under `strict`

principle.style_is_not_a_rule.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import doc;style=('style','naming','comment','layout','format');bad=[r.id for r in doc.RULES if r.id in style];print('style_ids=%d' % len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
principle.style_is_not_a_rule.note: style preferences (naming, comment density, file layout) do not enter the rule table; they are held by 'match the code around you'

principle.one_off_decisions_do_not_land.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'zreflect');import doc;hit=doc.round_narrative_problems();[print('%s:%s' % x) for x in hit] or print('round_narrative=%d' % len(hit));sys.exit(1 if hit else 0)"
principle.one_off_decisions_do_not_land.note: a one-off decision ('why this round changed this way') is not recorded in a document; it belongs to the commit message

principle.core_sealed.note: shared suite core modules and selftest yardsticks must match the hard SHA-256 seal (`zreflect/SEAL.json`)
